h1: Nicslongstay Hotel Wang Nam Khiao — Lakeside Cabins in an Agroforest, a Truly Private Getaway
intro: Picture this: you wake up, open the door of your own cabin, and there's a still lake with a thin mist drifting over the surface, forest and fruit orchards glowing green all around, and the cool Wang Nam Khiao air — so you hop in a kayak and paddle along the water before your first coffee. Nicslongstay Hotel, or Nicslongstay, is a small cabin resort at Ban Bu Sai, Thai Samakkhi sub-district, Wang Nam Khiao, Nakhon Ratchasima, with its cabins spread out as standalone units along a lake across more than 41 rai of agroforest · there are around 9 cabin types, from garden cabins and lakeside cabins to a villa jutting out over the lake, up to a big 3-bedroom house for large groups · free kayaks and bikes to use, a 360-degree viewpoint, and an owner who looks after guests like family · from around THB 1,165/night · backed by an Agoda Customer Review Award of 8.7 and a Tripadvisor score of 4.7 from real reviews.

body.html: Who Nicslongstay is for — to put it as simply as possible, Nicslongstay is a place for people who genuinely want to "disappear into nature, privately" in Wang Nam Khiao. It isn't a multi-storey hotel with rooms lined up floor by floor, and it isn't a big resort packed with activities and luxury · instead it's a set of standalone cabins spread out along a lake across more than 41 rai of agroforest at Ban Bu Sai, Thai Samakkhi sub-district, a zone known for the cool air and greenery of Wang Nam Khiao · the appeal here is the quiet and the friendly, owner-run feel, not a full lineup of city-hotel amenities · the people best suited to this place are couples who want to escape the bustle and have somewhere quiet, families bringing kids to run around in nature, and groups of friends or big families who want to book a whole large house together · the real reviews all point the same way: the people who leave impressed are the ones who came to slow down — to paddle, to cycle, to sit and watch the water — rather than those hoping to find a swimming pool, a restaurant, or a full slate of entertainment like a luxury resort · if you're looking for a stay near Khao Yai in an uncrowded setting and you don't mind driving out for a meal now and then, this place will hit the mark.

Location and getting there — Nicslongstay sits at 114 Moo 4, Ban Bu Sai, Thai Samakkhi sub-district, Wang Nam Khiao, on the hill slopes in the nature zone of Wang Nam Khiao · it's about 4–5 kilometres in from Wang Nam Khiao town, passing through the Thai Samakkhi community and fruit orchards, and within roughly 33 kilometres of Khao Yai National Park, so many people use it as a base before or after a Khao Yai day trip · the thing to be upfront about, per the real reviews, is that the final stretch of road before the property is rough and uneven in places, and you should keep GPS running the whole way, because it's a community road with poor signage · a regular sedan can make it in, but drive slowly and take care in the rainy season when the road can be slippery or have potholes · because it's a stay deep in nature like this, having your own car is almost essential — it's not ideal for people without one, since public transport is hard to come by and shops are some distance away · the upside of being tucked this far in is the quiet and privacy you can't get from a roadside stay, and waking up to a full view of nature every morning.

"The last stretch of road was a bit rough and you have to keep GPS on the whole time, but once you reach the place all the tiredness melts away — so quiet, just the sound of birds, and you wake up to mist drifting over the water. Worth the drive in."

Cabin types and decor — what sets Nicslongstay apart from the usual stay is that the cabins are standalone units, not rooms in a building, spread out along the lake and through the garden, about 9 in total, in a range of sizes to suit your group · it starts with the Fai House at around 24 sqm and the Garden House at around 34 sqm for 2 guests, ideal for couples · the lakeside Waterfront House group has several units from around 32 sqm up to 55–66 sqm with 2 bedrooms sleeping 4, good for small families · the highlight many people want is the Villa on the Lake at around 50 sqm, where the cabin juts out over the water and you open the door to a full view of the lake · the largest is the Large House at 145 sqm, with 3 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, and a living area, sleeping around 7, ideal for groups of friends or big families who want the whole house to themselves · the decor leans simple and warm in the style of a holiday cabin, using wood and natural tones to blend in with the surrounding garden · the real reviews agree that the cabins are clean, spacious and comfortable, and the views from them are lovely, especially the units right by the water · the in-cabin amenities cover the basics — air conditioning, TV, fridge and kettle — but understand that this is a nature cabin, not a hotel room loaded with every luxury · if the waterside view matters to you, ask specifically for a unit next to the lake when you book, because the view differs from cabin to cabin.

Facilities and activities — instead of a swimming pool or a spa like a city resort, the selling point of Nicslongstay is nature activities that are free to use · the most talked-about is the kayak, which you can paddle right on the lake in the middle of the property, and the bikes for cycling around the 41 rai of agroforest that's part forest, part fruit orchard · another distinctive feature is the 360-degree viewpoint building, which you climb for sunrise and sunset, looking out over the lake and the Wang Nam Khiao hills all around — a popular photo spot for guests · there's also a small cafe on site, free parking, free Wi-Fi in the common areas, a meeting room/group activity space, and luggage storage · to set expectations correctly, it has to be said that there's no swimming pool here, and it's not a full restaurant · the charm is in being with the water, the garden, and the cool air, rather than a full set of amenities · for people who came to slow down, this is exactly the point, but for anyone who wants a pool, a gym, or 24-hour service like a big hotel, choose a different type of stay.

Food and dining — this needs to be said clearly so you're not disappointed · Nicslongstay isn't a resort with a restaurant open for every meal like a city hotel, and breakfast isn't a standard service always included in every package — there's a small cafe and a kitchen for preparing food in some cabins · in practice, most guests drive out to eat at restaurants in Wang Nam Khiao town or the Thai Samakkhi community, where there are local eateries, mountain-view cafes, and Wang Nam Khiao souvenir shops to choose from · many cabins have a kitchen corner or basic equipment, so a lot of people choose to buy ingredients and cook for themselves or grill by the water, which fits the nature-cabin setting perfectly · so if you're planning a stay, sort out food in advance — ask the property beforehand whether they offer meals or breakfast during your visit, and if not, plan to buy groceries or eat out · this isn't a downside if you know it from the start, because sitting down to a meal by the water at your own cabin in the quiet is its own kind of charm that a city stay can't give you.

Service — this is one of the most praised things in the real reviews · because Nicslongstay is a small place where the owner lives on site and looks after guests personally, many reviews say the same thing: it feels more like staying at a relative's home than checking into a hotel · the owner and team are attentive, recommending places to visit, restaurants, and helping with the on-site activities · you can book or ask questions directly by phone, Line, and the property's Facebook, and they reply quickly and warmly · praise like "the owner takes care of you like family" and "service from the heart" comes up again and again across platforms · the flip side that comes with being a small place like this is that there's no 24-hour reception desk like a big hotel and there are few staff, so if you need help late at night or full hotel-style service, it may not be as immediate — but in exchange you get a warmth and friendliness a big hotel can't provide.

What real reviews say (praise and gripes) — pulling from Agoda, Trip.com and Tripadvisor, the picture is fairly consistent and clearly leans positive, with the property backed by an Agoda Customer Review Award of 8.7, a high recommendation rate, and Tripadvisor around 4.7 · On the praise side: the quiet natural setting by the lake, clean and spacious cabins, lovely views especially from the waterside units and the 360-degree viewpoint, free kayaking and cycling, the cool Wang Nam Khiao air, and most often mentioned of all, the owner and team who look after guests warmly, like family · On the gripes side: the final stretch of the access road is uneven in places and you have to rely on GPS, there's no swimming pool and no restaurant open for every meal so you need to sort out food or eat out, the internet and phone signal in some spots may be weak because it's out in nature, and it's a small place with no 24-hour service · almost all of these gripes come with being a "small nature stay" rather than being flaws — if you know and accept the nature of a place like this from the start, most people leave impressed.

"Came with the family and the kids loved kayaking — the owner is so lovely and looks after you like a relative. You just have to plan food a bit since there's no big restaurant; we drove out to eat in town and bought groceries to cook back at the cabin. It was fun."

Price and value — the starting rate for the small cabins is around THB 1,165/night in regular periods, rising with cabin size and the time of year · the waterside cabins and the Villa on the Lake sit higher up, while the Large House with 3 bedrooms for booking out as a group runs to several thousand a night — but split per head for a big group, it's good value · compared with other Wang Nam Khiao stays, Nicslongstay feels good value among standalone lakeside cabins, because you get privacy, natural views, and free kayaking and cycling at a price that's still accessible · the thing to weigh up is that compared with a Wang Nam Khiao resort that has a pool, a restaurant, and full breakfast, a similar price may give you more amenities — but you won't get this quiet and the private lakeside-cabin atmosphere · so the value here depends on how much you value "atmosphere and privacy" · for people who really came to relax in nature, every baht feels well spent.

Good to know before booking — a few things help make the trip smoother · one, because it's a small place out in nature, book and confirm details directly with the property by phone, Line, or Facebook, especially the cabin you want, the number of guests, and whether meals or breakfast are available during that period · two, if you want a waterside view, ask for a Waterfront House or Villa on the Lake when you book, because the view differs from cabin to cabin · three, keep GPS running and drive slowly on the road into the property, especially in the rainy season, and you should have your own car since public transport is hard to come by · four, sort out food in advance — note the eateries in Wang Nam Khiao town, or buy ingredients to cook/grill at the cabin · five, Wang Nam Khiao is cool, especially in the cool season and in the mornings, so bring warm clothing, and during long holidays the place fills up fast, so book ahead · six, allow for internet/phone signal that may be weak in some spots, which is part of getting a real break from your screen.

Bottom line — across all the real reviews, Nicslongstay Hotel is the best fit for people who want a private getaway in nature by the water at Wang Nam Khiao · standalone cabins along the lake, 41 rai of agroforest, free kayaking and cycling, a 360-degree viewpoint, and an owner who looks after you warmly like family give it a character that an ordinary resort can't match · if you're looking for a swimming pool, a restaurant open for every meal, 24-hour service, or an easy-to-reach roadside location, this may not be the answer, and you should consider a Wang Nam Khiao resort with fuller amenities · but for a trip where you want to escape the bustle, fall asleep to birdsong, paddle in the morning, cycle through the garden, and wake to mist over the water — Nicslongstay matches that almost perfectly, and it's why many guests say they'll come back.

faqTitle: Frequently asked questions — Nicslongstay Hotel Wang Nam Khiao

faq.q: Where is Nicslongstay Hotel, and how do you get there?
faq.a: The property is at 114 Moo 4, Ban Bu Sai, Thai Samakkhi sub-district, Wang Nam Khiao, Nakhon Ratchasima · it's about 4–5 km in from Wang Nam Khiao town and within roughly 33 km of Khao Yai National Park · we recommend driving yourself and keeping GPS on, because the final stretch is a community road that's uneven in places and hard for public transport to reach.

faq.q: What cabin types does Nicslongstay have, and what's the starting price?
faq.a: They're standalone cabins, around 9 of them in a range of sizes, from the Fai House/Garden House for 2 guests, the lakeside Waterfront House sleeping 2–4, the Villa on the Lake jutting out over the water, up to the 145 sqm Large House with 3 bedrooms for big groups · prices start at around THB 1,165/night in regular periods, rising with cabin size and the time of year.

faq.q: Does the property have a swimming pool and breakfast?
faq.a: There's no swimming pool, and it's not a restaurant open for every meal — there's a small cafe and some cabins have a kitchen corner · breakfast isn't a standard service in every package, so you should ask the property before booking and plan for food, for example eating out in Wang Nam Khiao town or buying ingredients to cook at the cabin.

The highlight is the free nature activities, namely kayaking on the lake and cycling around more than 41 rai of agroforest · there's a 360-degree viewpoint building for sunrise and sunset, looking out over the lake and the Wang Nam Khiao hills all around.

It's a great fit for couples, families, and groups of friends who want a private getaway in nature by the water · the large house is ideal to book out whole for a group · if you're looking for a swimming pool, a full restaurant, or 24-hour service like a big hotel, another type of Wang Nam Khiao resort may suit you better.

faq.q: How do you book Nicslongstay, and what are the review scores like?
faq.a: You can book via Agoda, Booking.com, Trip.com or contact the property directly by phone, Line, and Facebook · it's backed by an Agoda Customer Review Award of 8.7 with a high recommendation rate, and Tripadvisor around 4.7, with the recurring praise being the natural setting and the warm, attentive owner.
